data.name: Chastity & Modesty
text:
مرد بن مرد
Be a man
Urdu

چوڑیاں پہننا
to wear bangles (implying cowardice) from a man
Urdu

رن دے مرید دا منہ وی شرمندہ
A man excessively submissive to his wife constantly faces
humiliation.
Punjabi

رن نوں بھیت نہ دے
Never share critical, high-stakes secrets with a woman
because they can’t keep on
Punjabi

رن گئی جد پئی راہیں، گل گئی جد پئی صلاحیں
A woman is always going out and is very gullible because she
believes anyone’s advice
Punjabi

اوہو رانیاں جو خصماں بھانیاں
Only those women are true queens who are favored and loved
by their husbands.
Punjabi

بھیڑا کیتا خصمیں گالھ
A husband's poor deeds bring insult and dishonor upon
himself.
Punjabi

اندھیان دیاں وہٹیاں نوں سنگھار نال کیہ؟
What use is adornment and makeup for the wives of blind men?
Punjabi

رنڈی دی نہیں سنی جاندی، یتیماں دی سنی جاندی اے
Society turns a deaf ear to a destitute woman, whereas
orphans still elicit some sympathy.
Punjabi

رنڈی دے گھر منڈی
The house of an unprotected widow (or a prostitute) can
become a brothel
Punjabi

رنڈی پاوے بھنڈی
A widowed or destitute woman often faces societal slander
and public mockery.
Punjabi

رناں وچ بہوے تاں رنوں اکھواوے
A man who spends all his time sitting among women comes to
be called effeminate or henpecked.
Punjabi

رناں نال متھا لاوے تاں کناں دی خیر مناوے
If a man picks arguments with women, he should pray for the
safety of his ears.
Punjabi

رناں دی کھری پچھے مت
A traditional patriarchal adage claiming a woman's intellect
lags behind her heels.
Punjabi

رناں دی ذات بےوفا اے
A traditional cynical folk claim that women are unfaithful
by nature.
Punjabi

رن نوں رن چھیڑے، رن کولوں خدا ڈرے
When a woman provokes another woman, even God yields to the
resulting intense conflict.
Punjabi

رن ملی کپتی نہ ماری گئی نہ چٹی، غیب دی چٹی
Getting a malicious wife is an unescapable, unseen penalty;
she cannot be killed, nor loved, acting as a divine tax.
Punjabi

جس میں چمک نہیں وہ ہیرا نہیں، جس میں دمک نہیں وہ عورت نہیں
That which lacks luster is no diamond; she who lacks
beauty/allure is no true woman.
Urdu

اونٹ کی پکڑ اور عورت کے مکر سے اللہ بچائے
May God save us from a camel's grip and a woman's cunning.
Urdu

رن گئی پیر رلی بھی گئی
When the woman left, even the quilt/bedding went with her
(everything fell apart).
Seraiki

مرد رلے تا کھلے، رن رلے تا بھولے
If a man wanders, he prospers/gains exposure; if a woman
wanders, she forgets (strays into ruin).
Seraiki

ویلا نہ وقت، بی بی چڑھ بیٹھی تخت
Without rhyme or reason, the lady went and sat on the throne
Punjabi

چې عورت وي، غلطه وي
If she is a woman, she is automatically wrong.
Pashto

چې ښځې ته حال وایې، نو ډم ته یې ولې نه وایې
When you share a secret with a woman, why not just tell it
to a drummer?
Pashto

چې خدای یې کوي او ښځې یې کوي هغه کېږي
What God wills happens, and what a woman sets her mind to
happens.
Pashto

چې کونډه شي، په منډه شي
When a woman becomes a widow, she is constantly on the run.
Pashto

چې کوس یې کوږ وي، بخت یې خوږ وي
An ugly woman possesses the sweetest fortune.
Pashto

چې اوې خندل، نو پکې ده / جو हंस गए، وہ پھنس گئے
When she smiles, she is caught.
Pashto

د نړۍ ټولونه غټ دروغ دا دی چې درې ښځې په خاموشۍ ناستې وي
The biggest lie in the world is that three women sat
together quietly.
Pashto

د ښځو اوره، منه یې مه
Listen to women, but do not obey them.
Pashto

د ښځو کلي نه وي
Women have no native village of their own.
Pashto

د ښځو کار تل خراب وي
A woman's work is always flawed.
Pashto

د ښځو خوله سوري وي
Women's mouths have no locks.
Pashto

د ښځو نظر د کلي نه بهر نه لګېږي
A woman's vision does not extend beyond the edge of the
village.
Pashto

د ښځو شرم په ننواتو نه بېرته کېږي
A loss of female honor cannot be restored through apologies
or reparations.
Pashto

د ښځو زیارت نه وي
There are no shrines dedicated to female saints.
Pashto

د ښه خاوند نه نیمه کونا پټه، د بد خاوند نه ټوله کونا پټه
From a good husband hide half your secrets; from a bad
husband hide them all.
Pashto

د شپې ټولې ښځې یو شان وي
In the dark of night, all women are alike.
Pashto

هزاره ته روټۍ ګرانه ده او فدې ارزانه ده
In Hazara, bread is expensive and women are cheap.
Pashto

جینکۍ پلید بوټي دي، ژر ژر لویېږي
Girls are like weeds: they grow everywhere and quickly.
Pashto

که چېرې د الله نه علاوه بل چا ته سجده کېدله، نو ښځو به خاوند ته کوله
If prostration to anyone besides God were allowed, women
would prostrate to their husbands.
Pashto

ښځه د فساد ریښه ده
Woman is the root of all evil and strife.
Pashto

ښځه د پښو چپلۍ ده، که نه وي خوښه بدلول کړه
A woman is like footwear; if you dislike her, change her.
Pashto

ښځه ناقصه قوم دی
Women are an incomplete species.
Pashto

ښځه نه تخت غواړي نه بخت غواړي، د یو شی سخت غواړي
A woman desires neither crown nor fortune, but physical
fulfillment.
Pashto

ښځه په خېټه ډکه ساته، او په څپېړه یې لاندې ساته
Keep a woman's stomach full and her face under your
hand/slap.
Pashto

ښځې د خلق حجرې ته نه بیایي
Women should not be brought into public guest houses
(Hujras).
Pashto

ښځې ته دروغ ویلو کې ګناه نشته
Telling lies to one's wife carries no sin.
Pashto

ښځو بابا ادم له هم دوکه ورکړې وه
Women even managed to deceive Adam.
Pashto

کونا بربنډه بنګړي په لاس
Bare buttocks, yet bangles adorning her wrists.
Pashto

کوس مې کوس لاړو، خیر مې خیر ونشو
Giving vagina brought no spiritual reward.
Pashto

کوس ته ګوره په خوړ اودس ته ګوره
Look at a woman attempting ablution by the river stream!
Pashto

په غو مې غی، په کوس پسې مې خاندې
You use me sexually, yet you laugh at my body!
Pashto

پېشو هم د کوس مېرممن شوه
Even the cat claims ownership of a vagina!
Pashto

رنګ د ښځو ورک شه، بېخ اوباسي د سړو
May God protect men from the wiles of women.
Pashto

شاملات پېغله ښځه ده، چې د سر لاره د هغه شوه
Communal land is like a virgin girl; whoever tills it first
owns it.
Pashto

شرع کې روا دي، خو د خلقو نه په غلا دي
Though lawful in religion, it should remain hidden from
public view.
Pashto

شتمنده ښځه سړي نه غلام جوړوي
He who marries a wealthy woman turns himself into her
servant.
Pashto

অস্থানে তুলসী, অপাত্রে রূপসী
Holy basil growing in an improper place; a beautiful girl
wedded to an unworthy vessel.
Bengali

নদীর জল ঘোলাও ভালো, জাতের মেয়ে কালোও ভালো
Turbid river water is still good; a dark-complexioned girl
is good if she comes from a noble lineage.
Bengali

খানকি, তার আবার মান কী!
A prostitute has no honor or dignity to speak of.
Bengali

ঘৃতকুম্ভ সমা নারী তপ্তাঙ্গারসমঃ পুমান। তস্মাৎ ঘৃতঞ্চ বহ্নিঞ্চ নৈকত্র স্থাপয়েদ্বুধঃ ॥
Woman is like a pot of clarified butter; man is like burning
ember. A wise man never keeps them together.
Bengali

পতি বিনা গতি নাই
A woman has no direction, purpose, or refuge without a
husband.
Bengali

গাইচ্ছা মাগী গাছ বায়, নদী মাগী তামুক খায়
Women who climb trees or smoke tobacco by the river are
prostitutes.
Bengali

অবলার মুখই বল
A weak woman's only weapon is her tongue.
Bengali

পতির পায়ে থাকে মতি, তবে তারে বলে সতী
She whose devotion remains at her husband's feet is called a
chaste and true woman.
Bengali

নারীর বল চোখের জল
A woman's strength lies only in her tears.
Bengali

নাও, ঘোড়া, নারী; যে চড়বে তার ই
Boats, horses, and women belong entirely to whoever
rides/controls them.
Bengali

ঝি জব্দ কিলে, বউ জব্দ শিলে; পাড়া-পড়শী জব্দ চোখে আঙ্গুল দিলে
Maidservants are subdued with fists, wives with grinding
stones, and neighbors by pointing out their flaws directly.
Bengali

بد کردار رچ جاندی اے، بد زبان نہیں رچدی
A woman of moral laxity can manage to survive in a marriage,
but a foul-mouthed woman cannot.
Punjabi

گلی پئی تے وسنوں گئی
A woman who indulges in neighborhood gossip forfeits her
marital harmony.
Punjabi

قول ہارن جواناں دا کم نہیں
Backing out of one's word is not the trait of real men.
Punjabi

جب ناچنے لگی تو گھونگھٹ کیسا
When one starts dancing in public, why wear a veil?
Urdu

عورت اور شراب انسان کے ہوش و حواس گم کر دیتے ہیں
Women and wine make a man lose his senses.
Urdu

ویسوروتے دودور دی سور ٹوکھیر
Even a lizard may court a widow.
Khowar

خوش نو استاٰےدنیا نو اوشیا
The world cannot exist without a beloved.
Khowar

عورتو شونین دیت سوګونو پھیرین
Win a woman's favor through flattery and a plant through ash
fertilizer.
Khowar

کوس چوست بوک بوےَ وا کوس ٹون چھونجیر
Some men are blessed with charming wives; others carry
tightened slingshots.
Khowar

چستی بیر گلائی بیہچور
Beauty fades, but grievances persist.
Khowar

جم عورتو غاریہ پتہ بوئے،جم کولانو موسافریہ
A woman's skill is proven in the high pasture; a man's is
proven in travel.
Khowar

ناقابلو درونګ پیتین
An unskilled woman uses an excessively long thread.
Khowar

جنیں شیطان ءِ کدو انت۔
A woman is the nest/abode of Satan.
Balochi

جنیں ءِ لگام ءَ مرد داریت۔
The reins/control of a woman are in a man's hands.
Balochi

جنک لاج کنت بہا لک انت، مردیں کہ لاج کنت بہا کاہ انت۔
A shy woman is worth a hundred thousand; a shy man is worth
a blade of grass.
Balochi

جنیں ءِ عقل پاد ءِ پونزہ ءَ انت۔
A woman's intellect lies under her heel.
Balochi

جنیں ئے عقل تنگ انت۔
A woman's mind/understanding is narrow.
Balochi

جنیں کہ جنوزام بیت، سوچیت و سامان بیت۔
When a woman becomes a widow, she becomes like a burnt
object.
Balochi

جنیں کنیزگے، راست ئے کن ئے پروشیت۔
A woman is like a delicate stalk; if you try to force it
straight, it breaks.
Balochi

केस ना मेस बोडकीस बेस
Neither hair nor anything yet a widow is attractive.
Marathi

बोडकें न्हाले आणि पाणी वायां गेले
The widow bathed and the water was wasted. It is useless for
a widow to bathe and adorn herself as she has no husband.
Marathi

आपण नागवी पाहणारे लबाड
She herself is naked (shameless), (yet calls) those who are
looking at her wicked.
Marathi

एक गोरी बाहत्तर खोडी चोरी
One fair woman (and she has) seventy-two hidden vices.
Marathi

नकटीचे लग्नास सतराशें विघ्नें
There are seventeen hundred objections to a noseless woman's
marriage!
Marathi

फुकाची बाईल कशाला राहील
A woman who costs nothing; why will she remain? Others will
not serve us for nothing.
Marathi

बायकांची अक्कल चुलीपाशी
Women's wisdom is connected with the fire-place.
Marathi

बायकांचे गाणे आणि नागवे न्हाणे
Women's singing and naked bathing. Both are bad. Respectable
women in India do not sing and they bathe in their clothes.
Marathi

बायकोचा कावा न कळे ब्रह्मदेवा
Even Bramha does not know the schemings of a woman.
Marathi

लावशील लळा तर पडेल गळां
If you show her affection she will fall about your neck.
Marathi

स्त्रियांची वर्मे स्त्रियांस माहीत
Women know the foibles of women.
Marathi

स्त्रिया साधनानुकूल होत
Women are attracted by rich men. By a slight alteration it
may mean 'by riches;' and also, 'Women are subdued by
tricks.'
Marathi

फिरली नार तर भ्रतार मार
If the woman turn on her husband she may kill him.
Marathi

सावत्र आई विषय जाई
A step-mother, and no enjoyment.
Marathi

ఆడదాని మాట నీళ్ల మూట
A woman's word, a bundle of water. (A woman's mind and
winter wind change oft.)
Telugu

ఆడది బొంకితే గోడ పెట్టినట్లు మొగవాడు బొంకితే తడిక కట్టినట్లు
If a woman lies, it's like building a wall; if a man lies,
it's like putting up a mat (easily seen through).
Telugu

బుషిమూలము నదీమూలము స్త్రీ మూలము విచారించకూడదు
Enquire not into the origin of a Rishi, a river, or a woman.
Telugu

నవ్వే ఆడదాన్ని ఏడ్చే మొగవాన్ని నమ్మరాదు
A laughing woman and a crying man should not be trusted.
Telugu

మొయిలు విడిచిన యెండ మొగుడు విడిచిన ముండ పట్టి విడిచిన మండ రెత్తి విడిచిన కుండ తీక్ష్ణము
The heat of the sun emerging from the clouds—the passion of
a meretricious woman separated from her husband—the violence
of a bough bent and let go—the force of a pot lifted up and
dropped—are great. ("Give the water no passage; neither a
wicked woman liberty to gad abroad." Ecclesiasticus xxv.
25.)
Telugu

రంకాడనేర్చినమ్మ బొంకాడనేరదా
Will the woman who has learnt to play the harlot, not learn
to lie?
Telugu

లంజ చెడి యిల్లాలు అయినది
The changed harlot became an honest woman. (Ironical.)
Chastity gone once, gone for ever.
Telugu

తల్లి చేసినది తనయులకు
What a mother does, [falls] on her children. (If she sin,
her children are disgraced.)
Telugu

आत्मबुद्धिस्सुखं चैव गुरुबुद्धिर्विशेषतः। परबुद्धिर्विनाशाय स्त्रीबुद्धिः प्रलयंकरी॥
One's own resolve is happy, the priest's advice is better;
another's advice is for one's ruin, woman's counsel is
destructive.
Sanskrit

कार्येषु दासी करणेषु मंत्री रूपे च रंभा क्षमया धरित्री। भोज्येषु माता शयने तु वेश्या षड्धर्मयुक्ता खलु धर्मपत्नी॥
In work, a slave; in business, a minister; in form a Rambha;
in patience, [like] the earth; in [providing] food, a
mother; in conjugal enjoyments, a courtesan:—is not she who
possesses these six qualities, a dutiful wife?
Sanskrit

तस्करस्य वधो दंडो दासीदंडस्तु मुंडनं। भार्यादंडः पृथक्कुर्या मित्रदंडस्त्वभाषणं॥
Death is the punishment of a robber, the punishment of a
harlot is shaving the head; separation is the punishment of
a wife, the punishment of a friend is not speaking to him.
Sanskrit

दिवा काकत्रासिता॥
In the daytime she was frightened by the cawing of a crow.
(The feigned timidity of a loose woman.)
Sanskrit

न स्त्री स्वातंत्र्यमर्हति॥
A woman is not fit for independence.
Sanskrit

पुरुषाणामभावेन सर्वा नार्यः पतिव्रताः॥
In the absence of men, all women are chaste.
Sanskrit

पुस्तकं वनिता वित्तं परहस्तगतं गतं। अथवा पुनरायाति जीर्णं भ्रष्टं च खंडशः॥
A book, a woman, or money, when gone into the hand of
another, is gone [indeed]; or it returns worn out,
corrupted, or by bits.
Sanskrit

बद्धमूलस्य मूलं हि महद्वैरतरोः स्त्रियः॥
Women are the great root of the firmly-rooted tree of
enmity. ("Women and dogs set men together by the ears." "A
woman's vengeance knows no bounds." — German.)
Sanskrit

मातृहीनं भृशं जीवं तथा कान्तहीनं नवयौवनं तथा। शांतिहीनं तपः फलं तथा तिंत्रिणीरसविहीनभोजनं॥
Vain is the life of a motherless child, so is the prime [of
a woman] without a husband; penance without quietism is
fruitless, so is food without tamarind juice.
Sanskrit

कुग्रामवासः कुजनस्य सेवा कुभोजनं क्रोधमुखी च भार्या। मूर्खस्य पुत्रो विधवा च कन्या विनाग्निना संदहते शरीरं॥
Residence in a hamlet, service under a low fellow, coarse
food, an ill-tempered wife, a stubborn son, and a widowed
virgin [daughter] burn the body without fire.
Sanskrit

लज्जा स्त्रीभूषणं॥
Modesty is the ornament of women. ("I will therefore that
... women adorn themselves ... with shamefacedness." 1
Timothy ii. 8, 9.)
Sanskrit

वृद्धा वेश्या तपस्विनी॥
An old harlot, a female devotee.
Sanskrit

स्त्रियाश्चरितं पुरुषस्य भाग्यं देवा न जानंति कुतो मनुष्याः॥
The gods know not a woman's conduct and a man's fortune, how
then can men?
Sanskrit

स्त्रियो मूलमनर्थानां॥
Women are the cause of mischief.
Sanskrit

ન મળી નારી એટલે સહેજે થાવા બ્રહ્મચારી. વૃદ્ધા નારી પતિવ્રતા.
Not finding a wife, one easily becomes celibate. An old
woman is [naturally] a chaste wife. (Implies a woman's
fidelity is only assured once she is old and no longer
desired.)
Gujrati

data.name: Talkativeness
text:
دھی گئ ہاسے ، پُتر گیا تماشے
If a daughter gets used to laughter (casual gossip) and if a
son gets used to spending outside home, their future is
likely ruined
Punjabi

دھی پرائی اجڑی، ہسن ہارَا لوک
No translation
Punjabi

رن گئی سیاپے گھر آئی تاں جاپے
Women love to talk. So, even if they go to a place of
mourning, they find a way to engage in gossip.
Punjabi

د ښځې شل ګزه ژبه وي
A woman's tongue measures twenty meters.
Pashto

د ښځې وېښته اوږده دي، خو ژبه یې د هغې نه هم اوږده ده
A woman's hair is long, but her tongue is even longer.
Pashto

د ښځو خبره په یو غوږ اوره، په بل یې غورځوه
Listen to a woman's words through one ear and throw them out
the other.
Pashto

د ښځو خبرو نه شر جوړېږي
Women's talk breeds conflicts and strife.
Pashto

د ښځو سره چې څومره زیاتې خبرې کوې، دومره به دې د سترګو سړوالی کمېږي
The more you engage women in conversation, the more
authority you lose over them.
Pashto

د ځمکې نه او پښتنې ښځې نه ږغ نه راخېژي
Neither the earth nor a Pashtun woman should raise their
voice.
Pashto

ښځې ډېرې خبرې کوي ځکه چې د دوی دوه خولې وي، سړي ډېر سوچ کوي ځکه چې د دوی دوه سرونه وي
Women talk more having two mouths; men think more having two
heads.
Pashto

زما هم خوله کې ژبه شته خو په ژبه مې وېښته دی
I have a tongue in my mouth, but cotton covers it.
Pashto

ژبه او اوښکې د ښځې توره ده
A woman's primary weapons are her tongue and her tears.
Pashto

جنھے لایا گلیں، اودھے نال ٹر چلی
She follows anyone who engages her in smooth talk.
Punjabi

منہ دی کولی گلاں پٹاوے
A soft-spoken woman invites flirting / flirts with others.
Punjabi

ہوساک کیمیریو سار وفا نکی ڑینگاک دارو سار
Trust not in a giggling lady nor a quivering wood.
Khowar

روشت دنیو سار ڑینگاک دارو سار وا اوساک کیمیریو سار وفا نکی
Place no trust in a bright day, shaking wood, or a laughing
woman.
Khowar

لوٗو لوٹ کوریکو سار دونو لوٹ کو
Better (for a woman) to make a large block of butter than to
speak big words.
Khowar

غوٹو لوان غوٹو نان ہوش کوئے
Only a mother understands her mute child's unspoken words.
Khowar

جنیں پہ گپ، مردیں پہ کار۔
Women are for talking, men are for action.
Balochi

नारीचें बोलणें गवताचें शेकणें
A woman's talk (is like) heat from grass, i.e. it is
useless.
Marathi

data.name: Cunning & Evil
text:
رن دو دھاری چھری ہوندی اے
A cunning woman can act like a double-edged knife, cutting
both ways if mishandled.
Punjabi

ویہلی رن شیطان دا چرخہ
An idle woman's mind becomes a spinning wheel for the
devil's mischief.
Punjabi

مکھی، مچھی، استری، تینے ذات کذات
Flies, fish, and fickle women, all three are unpredictable
and unreliable by nature.
Punjabi

رن ویہلی ، چوسیلی
An idle woman becomes overly sharp-tongued, nitpicky, and
prone to creating mischief.
Punjabi

چې څومره ټېټه وي، دومره پلېته وي
The shorter the woman, the more wicked she is.
Pashto

د ښځو د یو وېښته / کمڅي لاندې سل مکرونه وي
Beneath every single hair of a woman lie a hundred
trickeries.
Pashto

که ورور ښه وای خدای به ځان له پیدا کړی و
If a brother were entirely good, God would have created one
for Himself.
Pashto

ښځه د شیطان نه اووه قدمه مخکې ځي
A woman walks seven steps ahead of the devil.
Pashto

شیطان چې کم کار په خپله نه شي کولای، هلته بوډۍ ښځه ولېږي
Where the devil cannot go himself, he sends an old woman.
Pashto

څوک چې د بل مور ته کنځلې کوي، د خپلې مور کنځلې به واوري
He who curses another's mother invites curses upon his own.
Pashto

অভাবে স্বভাব নষ্ট, মুখ নষ্ট বরণে / ঝড়তি কৃষতে নষ্ট, বউ নষ্ট মারণে
Poverty ruins character, pimples ruin the face, storms ruin
crops, and beating ruins a wife (makes her defiant).
Bengali

شکل چڑیلوں سی، مزاج پریوں کے
Looks like a witch, but puts on the temperament of a fairy.
Urdu

نو استونیرو ژٰاو ژٰاو نو، نو کرینیرو خانہ زاد خانہ زاد نو
A son born without labor pain will be disobedient, and a
servant bought free will be disloyal.
Khowar

چماچہ چوستی نکی ٹھاشٹا نخرہ
Little beauty, yet endless pretension.
Khowar

جنیں یار ئے شیطان ئے۔
A woman is a friend of the devil.
Balochi

गांवचा गांढ्या पण सासवेचा देशपांड्या
A fool in the village but a lord in the opinion of his
mother-in-law.
Marathi

आपलें तें बापडें दुसऱ्याचें तें कातडें
Our own child is tender, another's is (as tough as) leather.
Or the last word may be karate (an urchin). Sometimes the
two rhyming words are gojiravane (graceful) and laziravane
(graceless). 'Every man thinks his own geese swans'
(English).
Marathi

కుట్టిన తేలు గుణవంతురాలు కూశినమ్మ కుక్క ముండ
The scorpion which stung is a good tempered creature, the
[stung] woman who bawled out is a wretched slut. (A mischief
maker often escapes blame.)
Telugu

कोकिलानां खरो रूपं पातिव्रत्यं तु योषितां। विद्या रूपं विरूपाणां क्षमा रूपं तपस्विनां॥
The voice is the beauty of cuckoos; chastity is the beauty
of women; learning is the beauty of the deformed; patience
is the beauty of ascetics.
Sanskrit

दुर्जनं काञ्चनं भेरीं दुष्टस्त्रीं दुष्टवाहनं। इक्षुखण्डान् तिलाश्च्छूद्रान् मर्दयेदुत्तरोत्तरे॥
A bad man, gold, a drum, a bad woman, a bad horse, stalks of
sugar cane, sesamum seed, and Sudras should be beaten to
improve their qualities. ("A spaniel, a woman and a walnut
tree, the more they be beaten, the better they be.'')
Sanskrit

આદિ વેર ઘંટી તે ઘઉં, આદિ વેર સાસુ તે વહુ.
Primordial enmity [exists] between the grindstone and the
wheat; primordial enmity [exists] between mother-in-law and
daughter-in-law. (Listed alongside cat-and-mouse, thief-and-
honest-man as a 'natural,' inevitable enmity.)
Gujrati

data.name: Bride & Wife
text:
دھی ان بھاؤنا پروہنا اے
A daughter is like an unwelcome or temporary guest who must
inevitably depart for another household.
Punjabi

دھی ہسدی نہ مرے، دھی وسدی نہ مرے
A daughter should neither die while laughing (bringing
public scandal) nor while settled in her home (suffering
silently in marriage).
Punjabi

رن بیٹھی وگڑی، جیویں چھتھی گدڑی
An angry wife is like a female jackal
Punjabi

رن ٹوہے جیب، ماں ٹوہے پیٹ
A wife checks a man's pocket for money, whereas a mother
checks his stomach for hunger.
Punjabi

رن سوہنی تے جان دا کھوہ
An exceptionally beautiful wife becomes a source of endless
anxiety, jealousy, and danger to life.
Punjabi

نویں جتی نویں رن، دوویں دُکھ دندیاں نے
A new shoe and a new bride both cause discomfort until one
adapts to them.
Punjabi

جیہدی باندری اوہوای نچاوے
Only the owner can make his monkey dance (or: only the
husband should handle his wife).
Punjabi

بیوی کی موت اور کہنی کی چوٹ برابر ہوتی ہے
A wife's death is like a blow to the elbow: painful at
first, but quickly forgotten.
Urdu

نئی کنوار نواں ڈیہاں، چاندے فوکے دہ ڈیہاں، یارھوں ڈیہوں پیوس، کڑی ماں ویوس
A new bride is pampered for nine days, put to work by day
ten, and by day eleven she is relegated to the hearth.
Seraiki

گھر جائی گھر میں داجی
Born in the house, she becomes a dominant force/ruler inside
the house.
Seraiki

رن ٻہ دھاری چھری ہوندی آہے۔
A woman is like a double-edged sword.
Sindhi

پیڑھی ہلے پر نونہہ نہ ہلے
The stool/chair may shake, but the stubborn daughter-in-law
will not budge.
Punjabi

بوډۍ د شیطان ترور ده
An old woman is the devil's aunt.
Pashto

چې ژوندی وي د مېړه وي، چې مړه شي بیا د پلار
While a woman is alive, she belongs to her husband; when she
dies, she belongs to her father.
Pashto

چې په خاوند درنه وي، په ټول کلي درنه وي، او چې په خاوند سپکه وي، په ټول کلي سپکه وي
A woman's social status is relative to her husband's
treatment of her.
Pashto

چې روټۍ کمه شي کور واله ګرموه، چې سالن کم شي مېلمه ګرموه
When bread runs short, blame the wife; when broth runs
short, blame the guest.
Pashto

چې یوه وي ډېره ښه وي، چې دوه شي سنسانې شي، چې درې شي په خندق سره سواره شي
One woman in a house is good; two fight like crocodiles;
three ride the rooftops in chaos.
Pashto

د ښځې سوچ او د ژمي باد ژر بدلېږي
A woman's mind changes as quickly as winter wind.
Pashto

د کومې پېغلې چې صفت وکړې هغه متیزه تښتي
Praise a maiden too much and she will elope.
Pashto

د کونډې زوی د کونډې مېړه وي
A widow's son acts as her protector and husband figure.
Pashto

د سړي عزت د ښځې د پښو تر منځ دی
A man's honor resides between the legs of his woman.
Pashto

د سړي پته د ښځې نه معلومېږي
A man's character is judged by his wife's conduct and home
management.
Pashto

دویم خاوند د زنګون ټوټه ده
A second husband is like a knee patch.
Pashto

دوې ښځې چې کښېني د درېیمې وېښته یې په لاس کې وي
When two women sit together, they hold the hair of a third
woman.
Pashto

خاوند د ښځې د سر سیوری دی
The husband is a protective shadow over the wife's head.
Pashto

ښځه هیڅ کله هم وزګاره نه وي
A woman's domestic work is never done.
Pashto

ښځه او سړی د ژوند دوه پايې دي
Man and woman are the two wheels of the vehicle of life.
Pashto

ښځه او شیشه تل په خطر کې وي
A woman and a glass object are always in danger.
Pashto

ښځه په های پیدا کېږي، په های وادېږي، په های مړه کېږي
A woman is born in sorrow, married in sorrow, and dies in
sorrow.
Pashto

نازولې لور بده انګور وي
An overly pampered daughter makes a poor daughter-in-law.
Pashto

په ما یې ځکه زور دی چې د شپږ زامنو مور ده
She holds power over me because she is the mother of six
sons.
Pashto

په یوه ښځه کې خو سړی کونډ وي
A man with only one wife is practically a widower.
Pashto

ورځې دوه دي د خوشالۍ، اول چې زوی یې زېږي بل چې راوړي ناوکۍ
A mother has two days of pure joy: bearing a son and
bringing home his bride.
Pashto

বউয়ের চলন-ফেরন কেমন? / না, তুর্কী ঘোড়া যেমন; বউয়ের গলার স্বর কেমন? / না, শালিক কাঁকায় যেমন
How is the wife's behavior? Like a Turkish horse. How is the
wife's voice? Like a screaming myna/shrike.
Bengali

কাকিলা বধু ছেলে ধরতে জানে না
A gawky/cuckoo bride does not know how to hold or care for
her child.
Bengali

পয়সা নাই দুই আনা, বউ চায় সেয়ানা
He doesn't have two pennies, yet he wants a clever and
beautiful wife.
Bengali

বউ উঠতে ঠাঁই পায় না, উঠান জোড়া দাসী
The wife finds no room in her husband's home, yet he fills
the courtyard with concubines.
Bengali

কনের মা কাঁদে আর টাকার পুটুলা বাঁধে
The bride's mother weeps while tying up the money bag for
dowry.
Bengali

কথায় কথা বারে, জলে বারে ধান, বাপের বাড়ি থাকলে কন্যা বারে অপমান
Arguments breed arguments, water grows paddy, and an
unmarried daughter staying at her father's home brings
insult.
Bengali

এক বোরের স্ত্রী হেলাদোলা / দোজবরের স্ত্রী গলার মালা
The first wife of a man is neglected, but the second wife is
cherished like a necklace.
Bengali

যে রাঁধে, সে চুলও বাঁধে
She who cooks also manages to braid her hair.
Bengali

একা ঘরের একা বউ খেতে বড় সুখ / মারতে এলে ধরতে নাই তাই বড় দুঃখ
Living as the sole wife in a separate home is joyful, but
when the husband beats her, there is no one to stop him.
Bengali

গৃহ স্থির আগে কর, গৃহিনী স্থির তার পর
Secure and stable your house first, then subdue your wife.
Bengali

পতিহারা নারী, মাঝিহারা তরী
A husbandless woman is like a boat without a boatman.
Bengali

বউ নয় রে, বউ নয় ঘরোল ডাকিনী / দিনের বেলায় মানুষের ছা, রাত হলে বাঘিনী
She is no wife, but a household witch; a human child by day,
a tigress by night.
Bengali

جے شوہ آکھے فٹے منہ، تاں میں جیواں
When my husband rebukes me, only then do I feel
lively/reinvigorated.
Punjabi

جہرڑا رن دے آکھے لگے اوہ خراب تھیندا اے
He who follows the advice of his wife is destined to suffer.
Punjabi

حسین بیوی اور سرحدی قلعہ لڑائی جھگڑے کی جڑ ہیں
A beautiful wife and a border fort are the root of all
conflicts.
Urdu

جسے پیا چاہے وہی سہاگن
She whom the husband favors is the true wedded bride.
Urdu

چمئار کی جورو ٹوٹي جوتي
The cobbler's wife wears broken shoes.
Urdu

کیمیریو بیچو کوتیر
A woman is a dagger in the chest.
Khowar

ګون نیکیا وا مہ ژاوٗوت باردوخوتے بوک نو بوئے
Finding a wife for my son is as easy as finding a handle for
an axe.
Khowar

خورو بوک غیچا شیلی
Another man's wife looks beautiful in one's eyes.
Khowar

عورت پھیروانوں بچیں موش میدانوں بچیں
Man for the open field; woman for the domestic hearth.
Khowar

جنیں پاد ءِ سواس انت۔
The wife is a shoe for the foot.
Balochi

جنیں ءِ کور پُر انت بلے نہ تاچیت۔
A woman's river is full, yet it does not flow.
Balochi

جنیں ءَ بپست چو پس ءَ ترا وش نام کنت گوں ہر کس ءَ۔
Feed your wife like a goat and she will praise your name to
everyone.
Balochi

جنیں کپے بس انت۔
Half a wife was enough.
Balochi

नणंद आणि कळींचा आनंद
A husband's sister takes pleasure in mischief.
Marathi

नणंद खेळी रहाटाची फळी
A husband's sister is mischievous; she is like the board of
a spinning-mill. She sits quietly and sets others
quarrelling.
Marathi

कोणाला कशाचें व बोडकीला केसाचें
Some are thinking of their trials, the widow is thinking of
her hair.
Marathi

आपा घर की बाप घर
Her own house or her father's. There is no other place for a
married woman.
Marathi

एक तिडीक दे आणि घरची धनीण हो
Bear the pain once and become mistress of the house. The
wife's position is greatly improved after she has had a son.
Marathi

गौर रुसली सौभाग्य घेऊन बसली
The girl sulked and sat gravely like a married woman.
Marathi

जिकडे गेली वांझ तिकडे झाली सांज
Where the childless woman goes there she will stay till
evening.
Marathi

दुसऱ्याची स्त्री विष वल्ली
Another's wife is a poisonous plant.
Marathi

आपण विणा सवत साहीना
She herself does not bear children and yet she cannot endure
a fellow-wife. 'Dog in the manger' spirit.
Marathi

एका पुरुषाच्या दोन बायका घरांत किरकिर करूं नका
The two wives of one man, let them not quarrel in the house!
Marathi

चांगली बायको जगाची वाईट बायको मनाची
A good-looking wife is the world's, an ugly one is our own.
Marathi

जिच्या नवरा दास्यट तिचा संसार चोखट
She manages well whose husband is a slave to her. The Indian
wife is generally a good manager if left alone.
Marathi

जित्या नाहीं गोडी आणि मेल्या बंधनें तोडी
While he was alive she was not affectionate, now he is dead
she breaks her necklaces and bangles.
Marathi

जेथें दगड तेथें धगड
Where there is a (husband of) stone there will be a
paramour.
Marathi

जोरू साथ आणि पैसा गांठ
Tie up and carry with you your wife and your money. Neither
should be trusted to the care of another.
Marathi

डाग झाला जुना आणि मला पतिव्रता म्हणा
The thing has become old and (says) 'Call me a faithful
wife.'
Marathi

तरणीचे गाल म्हातारीचे हाल
The young wife's cheeks: the old wife's neglect. He is fond
of kissing his young wife.
Marathi

दादल्यापेक्षां बायको मोठी मुसळ घेऊन लागे पाठीं
If the wife be bigger than the husband she will run after
him with the pestle.
Marathi

नवऱ्याचें मारणें आणि चिखलांत पडणें
A husband's beating is like a fall in the mud. The
consequences are soon forgotten.
Marathi

नव्याचे नऊ दिवस मेल्याचे तीन दिवस
Of a new (husband) nine days, of a dead one three days. This
is how long a wife's love lasts!
Marathi

नव्या नव्या बायकांच्या नव्या नव्या परी पहिली होती ती असें नाहीं करी
New wives have new fancies, the first did not behave so.
Marathi

नाजूक नार आणि चाबकाचा मार
A delicate wife and beating with a whip. Perhaps implying
that if strong and robust the husband would think twice
before beating her.
Marathi

नावडतीचें मीठ अळणी आवडतीचा शेंबूड गोड
The salt of the disliked wife is tasteless, the mucus from
the nose of the favoured wife is pleasant. The two are wives
of one man.
Marathi

पतिव्रता नार रात्रीं हिंडे दारोदार
A faithful wife yet she goes from door to door at night.
Marathi

पतिव्रता नी मुसळ देवता
A faithful wife or the pestle as a god. (A story is told of
a devout wife pounding rice with a long pestle; when her
husband called her, she let go of the raised pestle to obey
him, and it stayed suspended in the air, proving her
faithfulness. Another wife, hoping for the same fame, tried
the same trick, but the pestle fell and bruised her head.
Now applied to one who boasts of her faithfulness, with the
reply: 'A faithful wife! yes, or else the pestle is your
god.')
Marathi

बायकांना लोण्याची सवतही सहन होत नाहीं
Women cannot endure a fellow-wife even if she be (soft as)
butter.
Marathi

बायको दुसरी फजिती तिसरी
A second wife; disgraceÊ a third thing. The two wives will
quarrel and bring disgrace.
Marathi

म्हातारा दादला जिवाला आधार
An old husband is a support to life. Or, perhaps better,
kunkumala adhar (an excuse for using the forehead mark),
i.e. it shows that she is a wife, not a widow.
Marathi

स्त्रियाचा जीव पती
The husband is the life of the woman.
Marathi

सासू सांजोऱ्या तळे माझा जीव जळे
Mother-in-law is making cakes: may my soul be burnt, i.e. I
need not expect to get any.
Marathi

अशी लेंक हवई घरोघर जांवई
A daughter so fair; a son-in-law from every house. All will
want to marry her. Another similar saying is Asa lenka dana
gharoghara suna (A son so good; a daughter-in-law from every
house).
Marathi

खायाला आजी करायाला शेजी
A grandmother at eating, a neighbour at working. One ready
to eat who keeps away when there is work.
Marathi

కడవంత గుమ్మడికాయ అయినా కత్తిపీటకు లోకువ
Although the pumpkin be as big as a large pot, yet it is
subject to the kitchen knife. However great a family a wife
may come from, she must still be subject to her husband.
Telugu

వెర్రివాడి పెండ్లాము వాడవదినా
A madman's wife is common property. (The helpless are mocked
and ill-treated.)
Telugu

नारीणां भूषणं पतिः॥
A husband is the ornament of women.
Sanskrit

वृद्धा नारी पतिव्रता॥
An old woman, a chaste wife.
Sanskrit

નારી ઘરનું નાક છે, નારી સુત દેનાર; નારીથી પંખાય છે, નારી સુખ આધાર. નારી વિનુ નિંદાય છે, નારી વિનુ નહીં સુખ; નારી વિનુ નહીં આભરણ, નારી વીસારો દુઃખ.
The wife is the honor ('nose') of the home; the wife is the
giver of sons; through the wife one flourishes; the wife is
the foundation of happiness. Without a wife one is
disgraced; without a wife there is no happiness; without a
wife there is no ornament; without a wife there is no
forgetting of sorrow. (A woman's value is defined entirely
through what she provides a husband/household, not as a
person in her own right.)
Gujrati

પરનારી તાતી છરી, નિત નિત કાપે કાય; જેના રહ્યા રામછ, તે પરનારી ઘર જય. પરનારી પ્રત્યક્ષ દેખો, વીખ હળાહળ અંગ; રાવણનાં દશ શિષ ગ્યા, પરનારી સંગ.
Another man's wife is a hot knife, constantly cutting the
body; [only] one who keeps to Ram [avoids] going to
another's wife's house. See another's wife as pure poison in
the flesh; Ravana lost his ten heads through [involvement
with] another's wife.
Gujrati

પીયા રંગ રાતી રહે, જગસે રહેત ઉદાસ; પીયા ચહા કે મત ચહા, મેં તો પીયહી દાસ. આજ્ઞાકારી પીયહી, રહે પીયહ સંગ; તનમનસેં સેવા કરે, ઓર ન દુજે રંગ. પતિવ્રતાકે તન નહીં, સુરત બસે પીય મન. પતિવ્રતા પતિકુ ભજે, કળહુ નામ નહીં લેત.
She stays dyed in the color of her beloved, indifferent to
the world; whether he desires her or not, she remains his
servant. Obedient to her husband, she stays by his side;
serves with body and mind, taking on no other color
[loyalty]. The devoted wife has no [awareness of her own]
body — her whole being dwells in her husband's mind. The
devoted wife worships her husband, yet never [dares to]
speak his name aloud. (The book's closing section,
prescribing a wife's total self-erasure and obedience as
virtue — including the old taboo against a wife ever saying
her husband's name.)
Gujrati

data.name: In-Laws
text:
دھی دے مُل جوائی
A son-in-law is what you get from giving away your daughter.
In someways, the ultimate measure of a daughter's worth and
destiny.
Punjabi

دھی کسے دی مندی نہیں، نونہہ کسے دی چنگی نہیں
No one considers their own daughter bad, and no one
considers their daughter-in-law good.
Punjabi

دھی نالوں جوائی مہنگا
The son-in-law is more precious than a daughter.
Punjabi

دھی والیاں دے گھر پھوہڑی
The house of those who have daughters is always filled with
worry and ongoing anxieties.
Punjabi

آؤن پرائیاں جائیاں، وچھوڑن سگیاں بھائیاں
Outsiders (wives from other families) arrive and end up
separating blood brothers.
Punjabi

غریب کی جورو سب کی بھابھی
A poor man's wife is treated as everyone's sister-in-law
(approachable/exploitable by all).
Urdu

آپ ہارے بہو کو مارے
Failing or losing oneself, one takes it out by beating the
daughter-in-law.
Urdu

جس کا گھر وہ ہی نہیں گھر
The home whose primary homemaker/master is absent ceases to
be a true home.
Urdu

اندېړ که لوېشت وي، ورېندار له بس ده
The sister-in-law may be just one foot tall, but she is
enough for her brother's wife.
Pashto

اندېړ کشره خواښې ده
The sister-in-law is a younger mother-in-law.
Pashto

د ادې واک تر کټوې پورې دی
A mother's authority is limited to the cooking pot.
Pashto

د باچا ورور نه ملنګ مېړه ښه وي
A beggar husband is better for a woman than living with a
brother who is a king.
Pashto

د ډیله سړي کور کې مېلمه مشر وي
In a hen-pecked man's house, a guest acts as the host.
Pashto

د جينۍ چې وېښته تور وي، یا لور وي یا انګور وي، چې وېښته یې سپين وي، یا خواښې شي یا مور وي
Black hair marks a daughter or daughter-in-law; grey hair
marks a mother or mother-in-law.
Pashto

د خوار / عاجز سړي عورت، د ټول کلي ورېندار وي
A poor man's wife is the sister-in-law of the whole village.
Pashto

د خواښې د انګور لوند سر بد اېسي
A mother-in-law dislikes seeing the wet hair of her
daughter-in-law.
Pashto

د خواښې او د انګور د شپې او د پېشو ده
A mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are like a dog and a
cat.
Pashto

د پېړۍ نه سوکه ولوېده، خواښې ته یې بهانه ترلاسه شوه
The daughter-in-law dropped a bit of dough, giving the
mother-in-law a reason to fight.
Pashto

د پلار د کور مې مېلمنه کړه خو کوربنه مې مه کړه
Let me be a guest in my father's home, not its permanent
host.
Pashto

په کور کې یو لیونی ښه وي
Every household needs at least one fierce/mad man.
Pashto

پښتون ته د زوم کره خوب نه ورځي
A Pashtun cannot sleep soundly in his son-in-law's house.
Pashto

سړی که کشر وي، د کور مشر وي
Even a young man is the head of his household.
Pashto

سړي کور جوړوي، ښځې یې ابادوي
Men build the house; women turn it into a home.
Pashto

تنګو مېوه نه ده، سندو رښته نه ده
Peaches are no real fruit; a wife's sister's husband is no
real relative.
Pashto

زما چې څوک سندو کېږي هغه ته زه سندا وایم
I view my wife's sister's husband as no better than a farm
bull.
Pashto

زوم د لستوڼي مار دی
A son-in-law is a snake hidden up your sleeve.
Pashto

ননদিনী রায় বাঘিনী / দাঁড়িয়ে আছে কাল সাপিনী
A sister-in-law is as scary as a tigress, standing like a
deadly cobra.
Bengali

মায়ে রাঁধে যেমন তেমন, বোনে রাঁধে পানি, ও অভাগী রাঁধে যেন চিনি পরমান্নি
Mother's cooking is ordinary, sister cooks like water, but
the pitiable wife's cooking is sweet like payesh.
Bengali

নিজের ভাই ভাত পায় না, শালীর তরে মণ্ডা
His own brother goes without rice, yet he buys sweets for
his wife's sister.
Bengali

অনেক কালের ছিল পাপ, ছেলে হলো সতীনরে বাপ
It was the result of an ancient sin that my son became the
father-in-law of my co-wife.
Bengali

লোহা জব্দ কামারবাড়ি, মেয়ে জব্দ শ্বশুরবাড়ি
Iron is tamed at the blacksmith's forge; a woman is tamed at
her in-laws' house.
Bengali

দাদা কি বউ মারে / গামছার বাড়া মেরে তামসা করে
Does brother beat his wife? He merely strikes her with a
towel for fun!
Bengali

ঝি কে মেরে বউ কে শেখানো
Beating the maidservant to discipline and teach the
daughter-in-law.
Bengali

گلاں ولوں میں وڈی، کارتُوتاں وڈی جٹھانی
I am senior in verbal chatter, but my sister-in-law is
senior in actual deeds.
Punjabi

تا موش ما موش بول
Your husband and mine together create an army.
Khowar

ای ژور جوش جمار
One daughter attracts ten prospective sons-in-law.
Khowar

برات اگر کور انت، گوہار چمدار انت۔
A sister looks up to her brother for support, even if he is
blind.
Balochi

گوہار و جن ءِ پاسبان خدا انت۔
God is the ultimate guardian of a wife and a sister.
Balochi

दरिद्री सार्यांचा मेहुणा
A poor man is brother-in-law of all.
Marathi

दादा अंगी वहिनी सोयरी
A brother is one's own flesh, his wife is only a relative.
Marathi

दादाची किल्ली वहिनीपाशी
My brother's key is with his wife. She can influence him.
Also a similar proverb, Dadaci khoda vahinila mahita (My
brother's bad habit is known to my brother's wife).
Marathi

सोयऱ्यांत साळा हत्यारांत भाला
A brother-in-law among relatives; a spear among weapons.
These are good.
Marathi

कागा बाई दुबळी म्हणे निघाले वेगळी
O madam! why are you so thin? 'I have separated from my
husband.'
Marathi

कशी गे सुने घरासारखी
O daughter-in-law! why are you behaving so? (She answers)
'Like the household.'
Marathi

कानाला कोंपर झडेना सासू मेली जांवई रडेना
The elbow will not touch the ear and the son-in-law will not
cry when his mother-in-law dies.
Marathi

चार दिवस सासूचे चार दिवस सुनेचे
Four days of the mother-in-law's (authority) and four days
of the daughter-in-law's. The latter asserts her authority
when she has children.
Marathi

पोराला पंतोजी व पोरीला सासू
A teacher for a boy,Ê a mother-in-law for a girl. The one is
the equivalent of the other.
Marathi

बोले धुवे लागे सुने
Whether talking or cleaning (the pots) it affects the
daughter-in-law. Whatever the mother-in-law says or does is
intended to reprove the daughter-in-law. If dhuva means
'daughter' (Molesworth) then the proverb would be, 'What is
said to the daughter is meant for the daughter-in-law.'
Marathi

माहेरचें सुख सासरीं होतें दुःख
(The girl feels) happiness at home but pain at her mother-
in-law's.
Marathi

लेंकीस बोले सुनेस लागे
What is said to the daughter is meant for the daughter-in-
law. So that the girl may not complain to her mother or her
husband, the sasu addresses her own daughter, urges her to
work, chides her for laziness, etc., but all the time she
intends it for her daughter-in-law. The first words may be
kombadisa bole (What is said to the fowls).
Marathi

वेडीला सासर काय आणि माहेर काय
What is a mother-in-law's house or a mother's house to a mad
woman? She would be mad indeed not to know the difference.
Marathi

सासरीं जातां कुचकुच कांटे माहेरीं येतां हरीख वाटे
She walks on thorns to her mother-in-law's, but she feels
delight in coming to her mother's house.
Marathi

सासवेचे दोंदावर जांवई उदार
The son-in-law is liberal with the distended paunch
(property) of his mother-in-law.
Marathi

सासू गेली ठीक झालें घरदार हातीं आलें
I am glad mother-in-law has gone (is dead), the whole house
is now in my hands. The last phrase is also quoted tupatse
gadage hati ale (the butter-pot has come into my charge).
Marathi

सासूचा पाय सुनेला लागला सुनेचा पाय सासूला लागला तरी सुनेनेच पाया पडावें
If the mother-in-law's foot knock against the daughter-in-
law, or if the daughter-in-law's foot knock against the
mother-in-law, it is the daughter-in-law who must beg
pardon.
Marathi

सासूची वाईट खोड नवरा व मी असले गोड मग इला येतो फोडा
Mother-in-law's bad habit; she hates my husband to be kind
to me.
Marathi

सासूपणा आला म्हणजे सूनपणाचा जाच विसरते
On becoming a mother-in-law the torments of being a
daughter-in-law are forgotten.
Marathi

सासूमागें सून नाचे
The daughter-in-law must dance to the mother-in-law's tune.
Marathi

सासूला मार आणि सुनेला धाक
Beat the mother-in-law and the daughter-in-law will be
afraid.
Marathi

सुनेला दडपण सासू
The mother-in-law is a check on the daughter-in-law.
Marathi

जांवई शोध
A son-in-law search. He is petted and feasted when he visits
his wife's relatives.
Marathi

కులమింటి కోతి అయినా మేలు
A monkey [-like wife] of good family is better [than a
pretty wife of low origin].
Telugu

data.name: Eating Habits
text:
چې غوا غوجلې له ځي، بدرۍ/خدرۍ مېچنې له ځي
When it is time to milk the cow, the disorganized woman
starts grinding grain.
Pashto

شکور دې ډک وي، که د پیاڅو وي که انګانو
Keep the bread basket full, whether with barley or wheat.
Pashto

রাঁধা বাড়াবো নারী, পুরুষের আগ খায় / ভরা কলসীর জল তার তরাসে শুকায়
A woman who eats before the men of the house will have a
fruitless and dried-up life.
Bengali

گلیں لگی تے اٹا کتیاں کھادا
She got absorbed in gossip while the dogs ate the flour.
Punjabi

برات ءِ شوڈکیں لاپ سیر بیت، گوہار ءِ سوتکگیں مگونگ درا نبیت۔
A brother's hungry stomach eventually gets filled, but a
sister's burnt wound never heals.
Balochi

व्याह्या जांवयां तुपाचा पेला आणि घरचा पाहुणा उपाशी मेला
A cup of butter to the son-in-law and his father while the
guest dies of starvation.
Marathi

रांड बिंड म्हणा आणि पोटभर वाढा
Call me a widow or what you like but give me enough to eat.
Marathi

शिळी भाकर ताकानें गोड व वाईट बायको पोरानें गोड
Stale bread is sweet with butter-milk and a bad wife becomes
sweet when she has a child.
Marathi

स्त्रीणां द्विगुणमाहारो बुद्धिश्चापि चतुर्गुणा। साहसं षड्गुणं चैव कामोऽष्टगुण उच्यते॥
Women are said to eat twice as much [as men], to have four
times as much sense, six times as much pluck, and eight
times as much desire.
Sanskrit

data.name: Idle & Useless
text:
ویہلی رن پرونیاں جوگی
An idle woman avoids actual household work and instead
contents herself with just chatting with guests.
Punjabi

چې د ژرندې لاندې پُل یې ګرځي، پوه شه چې کار خراب دی
When the lower grinding stone moves on its own, know
something is wrong.
Pashto

ځان چې خاورې کړي، نو رڼا ورځ به مومي
Humble yourself to dust today to see a bright tomorrow.
Pashto

چپ چپِیتی کم سنوارے
A quiet, silent woman efficiently manages household tasks.
Punjabi

مرض دا بولیا تے فجر دا گرجیا برتھا نہ جائے
A man's word and the early morning thunder never go to
waste.
Punjabi

बोडकीला कुंकू व वांझेला कातबोळा
Forehead-powder to a widow, and katabola (medicine) to a
barren woman. Both useless.
Marathi

data.name: Authority
text:
د سړي کار ته ګوره، غټ وړوکی یې څه کوې
Look at a man's deeds, not his physical height or stature.
Pashto

که ښځې ښې وای نو چیرته به پکې پیامبر راغلی و
If women were fit for supreme leadership, there would have
been female prophets.
Pashto

کوم سړی چې کور نه شي سنبالولی هغه د کلي مشري نه شي کولای
A man who cannot control his household cannot lead his
village.
Pashto

نور د غرو سر وهي، نامرده خپل ټبر وهي
A brave man conquers mountain peaks; a coward beats his
wife.
Pashto

سړو ته خدای عزت ورکړی دی
God has granted men natural authority over women.
Pashto

یو به دې پېسو ساتي، یو به دې جرګو ساتي، یو به دې توپکو طماچو ساتي
A family needs three men: one to earn, one for councils, and
one for defense.
Pashto

থাকে যদি চূড়ো বাঁশী, মিলবে রাধা হেন কত দাসী
If one possesses the crown and flute, many servants like
Radha will readily be found.
Bengali

کھونگیر دیاک ژاوَو سار ورنگوشٹی موش جم
An idle husband is better than a warrior son.
Khowar

گوہار کہ برات نیست، بزاں کلات ءِ واجہ ئے مان نیست۔
A woman without a brother is like a fortress without a
master.
Balochi

त्याचा बाप तोच
He is his own father. It is a father's duty to punish; here,
he is punishing himself by his folly, and therefore is his
own father.
Marathi

दत्त म्हणून उभा
Adopted therefore he stands forward.
Marathi

ఆడ పైత్తనము తంబళి దొరతనము
Woman's rule, a Tambali's government. (A Tambali is a Saiva
priest of low origin, who wears the sacred thread and
endeavours to observe Brahminical customs.)
Telugu

బహునాయకం బాలనాయకం స్త్రీనాయకం
Having many leaders, having a youthful leader, having a
female leader (Is equally bad). (Said of people, an army,
etc.)
Telugu

अनायका विनश्यन्ति नश्यन्ति शिशुनायकाः। स्त्रीनायका विनश्यन्ति नश्यन्ति बहुनायकाः॥
Those without a leader perish; those with a youthful leader
perish; those with a female leader perish; those with many
leaders perish.
Sanskrit

पिता च ऋणवान् शत्रुर्माता च व्यभिचारिणी। भार्या रूपवती शत्रुः पुत्रश्शत्रुरपण्डितः॥
A father in debt is an enemy [to his son]; a mother of bad
conduct is an enemy [to her son]; a beautiful wife is an
enemy [to her husband]; an unlearned son is an enemy [to his
parents].
Sanskrit

राजा राष्ट्रकृतं पापं राजपापं पुरोहितः। भर्ता च स्त्रीकृतं पापं शिष्यपापं गुरुर्भजेत्॥
The king must answer for his country's sin; the priest for
the king's sin; the husband for the wife's sin, and the Guru
for the disciple's sin.
Sanskrit

data.name: Intelligence
text:
د یوې پښتنې ښځې عقل د نهو نایانو او جولګانو برابر دی
The intellect of one Pashtun man equals nine Pashtun women,
and one Pashtun woman equals nine non-Pashtuns.
Pashto

دنګه ښځه کم عقل وي
The taller the woman, the lesser her intellect.
Pashto

ځوان د خسو هم ښه وي
A young man is valuable even if made of straw.
Pashto

আহাম্মক আত; যে মাগকে পাঠায় হাট
He is a fool of the highest order who sends his wife to the
public market.
Bengali

منہ تے کہوے تاں مرد منو
Consider him a true man who speaks the truth face-to-face.
Punjabi

جنیں کچنـبکیں پہ گشگ شرکار نبیت۔
A corrupt/stubborn woman cannot be made good by mere advice.
Balochi

data.name: Age
text:
بُڈھے دی رَن ناں مرے، تے بال دی ماں ناں مرے
May an old man's wife not die, and may a child's mother not
die. Reflects rural social structures where elderly men and
young children rely entirely on domestic caregiving from
their mothers/wives.
Punjabi

د سپېرې ښځې سل کاله عمر وي
A shrewish woman lives for a hundred years.
Pashto

پروا مې درته نشته که ته تېر شې په لنډن، اوس مې ژنړي دي زامن
Go beyond London for all I care; my sons are grown now.
Pashto

سړی چې د شپېتو شي، د وېشتو شي
When a man turns sixty, he is fit to be shot.
Pashto

data.name: Property & Wealth
text:
جھگڑے کی باتیں تین: زن، زر، زمین
The causes of all strife are three: Woman, Wealth, and Land.
Urdu

د کور خبره بهر مه کوه او د بهر خبره کور ته مه راوړه
Keep household matters inside and external matters outside.
Pashto

خور لور د امیر سړي کوه، او غوا د غریب سړي کوه
Marry the daughter of a rich man; buy the cow of a poor man.
Pashto

مال مې د سر نه زار، سر مې د ناموسه
Sacrifice wealth for life; sacrifice life for honor and
women.
Pashto

उत्तमं स्वार्जितं वित्तं मध्यमं पित्रार्जितम्। अधमं भ्रातृवित्तं च स्त्रीवित्तमधमाधमम्॥
[To live upon] self-acquired property is good, [to live
upon] that acquired by a father is middling, [to live upon]
a brother's property is low, [to live upon] a woman's
property is the lowest of the low.
Sanskrit

data.name: Marriage
text:
دھی اسری کھان پین و سرین
As a daughter grows up, her personal household expenses and
dowry requirements grow alongside her.
Punjabi

رن ویاہی تاں اندے پائی
Marrying a woman brings immediate financial, emotional, and
social entanglements.
Punjabi

بارہ عورتوں، ہک مرد، تڏانہیں تھیئے شہیدی پوری
Twelve women and one man, only then is a complete testimony
formed.
Seraiki

د دوو / لسو روپیو ناوې خو به په کټ کې متیازې کوي
A cheap ten-rupee bride will end up wetting the wedding bed.
Pashto

د انسان خوشبختي او نېكبختي د هغه ښځې سره اړې لګي
A man's good or bad fortune depends on his wife.
Pashto

د ناوې خاموشي د ناوې رضا وي
A bride's silence indicates her consent.
Pashto

جېنۍ چې د زانګو نه کوزېږي، واده ورته کوئ
As soon as a girl steps down from her swing, marry her off.
Pashto

خاوند کول اسان دي خو چوله اچول ګران دي
Marrying a man is easy; maintaining a home is difficult.
Pashto

ښځه په نکاح ده، ځمکه په انتقال
A woman's possession is confirmed by marriage; land by
transfer papers.
Pashto

نر چې واده وکړي هله سړی شي
A male becomes a complete man only upon marriage.
Pashto

কনের বাপ বসে বসে চোখের জলে ভাসে, বরের বাপ বসে আছে পাঁচশো টাকার আশে
The bride's father sits in tears, while the groom's father
waits eagerly to count five hundred rupees.
Bengali

অভাগার গরু মরে, ভাগ্যবানের বউ মরে
An unlucky man loses his cattle; a fortunate man loses his
wife.
Bengali

برارو لوڑی اسپرارو الوس
See the brother and marry his sister.
Khowar

موش بوکانتے ٹونگ چھانا ژاغا بویئے
A pearl leaf is enough space for a husband and wife.
Khowar

ای روپیہ سوت استری
Seven wives for one single coin.
Khowar

سکی اں برات مرکب اں اوشتان، وشیاں اتونیں جن اوں نوشاں۔
In hardship, brothers stand like riding camels; in
happiness, one enjoys with a wife.
Balochi

جنیں پہ نشگ ءَ، مردیں پہ دیوان ءَ۔
Women are for sitting at home, men are for the public
council (dewan).
Balochi

मागून पुढून बापच नवरा
First and last father is the bridegroom. A widower
remarrying who does not arrange for his son's marriage.
Marathi

नवें नवें जेवी सवें
While new they dine together! Refers to newly-married
people. After a time the husband takes his meal first.
Marathi

नावडतीची आली पाळी गांवाची झाली होळी
The turn of the disliked wife came and the village was set
on fire. The man's two wives take turns in cooking. The holi
is a pile of wood burnt at the Holi festival.
Marathi

మున్నూరు శిఖలయినా కూడ వచ్చునుగాని మూడు కొప్పులు కూడ రాదు
Three hundred Sikhas (i.e. men) may come together, but three
Koppus (i.e. women) should not get together. (Sikha is the
top-lock worn by men and Koppu is a woman's chignon.)
Telugu

ગાય લેવી દુઝતી, વહુ લેવી શોભતી.
Take a cow that gives milk; take a daughter-in-law (bride)
who is beautiful. (Choosing a bride is likened to choosing
livestock — for her looks/usefulness.)
Gujrati

data.name: Children
text:
بانجھ چنگی، اکونج بُری
Being childless is better than one having a single child
because one can marry again with a wife who bears no
children.
Punjabi

پُتراں دیاں ماواں دے وڈے وڈے جگرے
Mothers of sons possess immense courage as they are backed
by their sons.
Punjabi

جٹا! تیرے نال بُری ہوئی، گھر آئیاں نوں کُڑّی ہوئی
Jutta, misfortune has struck you! A daughter was born in
your home.
Punjabi

دھی جَمدی مر جاوے جِہدا دُکھ وی نہ آوے
Better that a daughter dies at birth so that her lifelong
hardships and grief never occur.
Punjabi

دھی دھریک تے پتر امب
A daughter is like a chinaberry (dharaik) tree, while a son
is like a mango tree. (Dharaik tree grows up very quickly
while the mango tree takes a longer time to mature.)
Punjabi

دھی پنگھوڑے لے آئی ادھورے
Refers to a daughter prematurely bringing incomplete burdens
or domestic responsibilities right from childhood/cradle.
Punjabi

دھیاں جمدیاں نوں ہے ہے
The birth of daughters is met with immediate collective
sighs and systemic worries.
Punjabi

دھیاں دی ماں رانی، بڑھاپے بھرسی پانی
A mother of daughters rules like a queen when they are
young, but must draw water herself in old age once they
marry away.
Punjabi

دھیاں کونجاں سدا پردیسی
Daughters are like migratory cranes, forever destined to
depart for foreign lands.
Punjabi

رن تے بال دونویں روبرو چنگے
A wife and a young child are best managed and cared for when
kept directly before one's eyes.
Punjabi

سر تے گت تے کچھڑ بال، ، مینوں کدی پرواہ
With hair tied up on the head and a baby in arms, a mother
fears nothing and marches forward carelessly.
Punjabi

ڈٹھی چٹی چمڑی، بھول گئی امڑی
Upon seeing fair skin (a fair-complexioned woman), he
completely forgot his own mother.
Seraiki

ابو گاسے، دھیئے واسے
The father wears himself out working so that his daughter
may settle comfortably in her home.
Seraiki

جیہا دودھ، تیہی بدھ
As is the mother's milk, so is the child's intellect and
character.
Punjabi

چې څومره یې زامن وي، دومره قدرمن وي
The more sons a person has, the greater their social status
and respect.
Pashto

هلکان او جينکۍ چې يو ځای لوبې کوي نو ښکر لکه به یې اوشي
A boy playing with girls grows horns; a girl playing with
boys grows a tail.
Pashto

د ښځې سیوری به بل سړي په سر وي
A girl's shadow ultimately falls on another man's head.
Pashto

د لوڼو پلار تل ستړی وي
A father of daughters is never at peace.
Pashto

د سیالۍ هر کار اسان دی خو زوی زېږول ګران دی
One can compete in anything except in bearing a male child.
Pashto

د زامنو نوم خوږ دی خو چا ورته څه وکړل
Sweet is the name of sons, yet they rarely live up to every
expectation.
Pashto

که مور خره وي، اولاد ته ښه وي
Though the mother may be a donkey, she remains precious to
her children.
Pashto

که شپه تیاره ده، خور لور ښکاره ده
Though the night is dark, sisters and daughters remain
distinct.
Pashto

کوم کور کې چې لور اوشي هغه کې اووه نور بهېږي
The birth of a daughter brings seven divine blessings to the
home.
Pashto

ښځه لور لویل بل له خواري کول دي
Raising a daughter is working hard for another man.
Pashto

خور لور د پردي ډېران خځل ده
A daughter is trash on someone else's dunghill.
Pashto

لور چې کله برخه وغواړي، هغه لور نه پاتې کېږي
When a daughter demands her inheritance, she forfeits her
status as a daughter.
Pashto

لور د بل کور ده
A daughter belongs to someone else's house.
Pashto

لور د مور د لېچې وزرې دي
A daughter is her mother's helping hands and wings.
Pashto

لور د شرم ټوکرۍ ده، د بل اوږو یې واچوه
A daughter is a basket of shame; hand her over to another as
soon as possible.
Pashto

لور خو د ښو غمونه یې ډېر وي
A daughter is cherished, yet she brings endless worries.
Pashto

لور یې غلا، مور یې ملا
The daughter steals; the mother acts as master mind.
Pashto

نر زوی د ښځې موګی دی
A male son is the peg to which a woman anchors her home.
Pashto

په لور هم غم تود وي، هم ښادي
A daughter shares deeply in both her parents' grief and joy.
Pashto

طور د وي خو څلور د وي
Let there be four sons, even if they are plain.
Pashto

وړنګ سړی خدای پاک په لوڼو سموي
When God wants to humble a proud man, He grants him
daughters.
Pashto

زامنو د کور وېشي، لوڼه غمونه
Sons divide the estate; daughters divide the grief.
Pashto

زوی د پلار اوږې دي
A son acts as his father's supporting shoulders.
Pashto

কানা পুতে পোষে, রাজার ঝিয়ে শোষে
Even a blind son supports his mother, but even a king's
daughter exploits her father.
Bengali

ছেলে বিয়ালে স্বর্গবাস, মেয়ে বিয়ালে নরকবাস
Giving birth to a son feels like dwelling in heaven; giving
birth to a daughter feels like dwelling in hell.
Bengali

অপুত্রকং গৃহং শূন্যং
A household is completely empty and desolate without a son.
Bengali

যার ঝি তার পোড়া / পাড়াপড়শীর কান খাড়া
A daughter's tragedy concerns her father, but neighbors perk
up their ears to gossip.
Bengali

ছেলের মুত কড়া / মেয়ের গলায় দড়া
A son's urine generates wealth, while a daughter should hang
herself with a rope.
Bengali

ছেলে শিখবে লেখাপড়া, মেয়ে শিখবে রান্না করা
Boys should pursue education; girls should learn cooking and
household chores.
Bengali

পিতা রক্ষতি কৌুমারে ভর্তা রক্ষতি যৌবনে। রক্ষন্তি স্থবিরে পুত্রান ন স্ত্রী স্বাতন্ত্র্যমহতি ॥
Father protects her in childhood, husband protects her in
youth, sons protect her in old age; a woman is never fit for
independence.
Bengali

ژاوٗو اژیکو انوس زور
Stern is the birth of a son.
Khowar

ای ادینہ کی گوئے تان ژاٰوو خدایئ دوم
If there were only one Friday, I would gladly sacrifice my
son.
Khowar

ژور دیتی ژاٗو کرینے
Give a daughter and obtain a son.
Khowar

شوم ژاوٗوتے کیا یراغ شوم ژوروتے کیا زیوور
No need to arm an unruly son, and no need to adorn an unruly
daughter.
Khowar

ای اوشپوڑو سم غیچ نکی ای ژورو سوم
Neither a tumor nor a daughter has eyes.
Khowar

چھانی کی نیسایے بسیرو وایے کام بویے
When the kid is born, the mother goat's market value
decreases.
Khowar

عورتو شونګہ ژانگ کولانو ژانگہ
A woman fights her battle in childbed; a man fights his on
the battlefield.
Khowar

چیق کی کیڑیتاٰے نان تو دایئر
The mother feeds her child only when he cries.
Khowar

برات گوہارانی آہنی پھل انت، پِت جنکانی سایگ انت سردیں، مات جنکانی شگ و آدینک انت۔
A brother is a strong iron wall of protection for sisters; a
father is a cool shadow for daughters; a mother is a comb
and mirror for girls.
Balochi

جنیں چک نان پہ قسمت وارت۔
A female child gets her food only by luck/destiny.
Balochi

جنیں چک مثال ءِ پل اے۔ روچے نہ روچے یکے زرت ئے روت۔
A daughter is like a flower; one day someone will come and
pick her away.
Balochi

جنیں چک پہ لوگ ءَ، مردیں چک پہ سیل و ساد۔
A female child is for the house; a male child is for outings
and the public sphere.
Balochi

جنیں چک چربیں زک ے۔
A female child is like an oily leather skin container.
Balochi

डोहाळ्यावरून मुलाची लक्षणें ओळखावीं
A child's character may be known by the mother's longings
(during pregnancy).
Marathi

दुबळी आई आणि कोरडी नाई
A poor mother is like a dry river.
Marathi

बापानें मुलाला मारलें तरी वेगळा होत नाहीं
Although the father beat his son they do not separate from
each other.
Marathi

बेटी बापाची जमीन पादशाहाची
A daughter is her father's (just as) the land is the
emperor's. He arranges for her marriage.
Marathi

लेंक असली परी परी तरी परघरीं जाणारी
Although a daughter be a fairy she will go to a stranger's
house, i.e. she will marry.
Marathi

एक पुती रडती दुपुती रडती सातपुती रडती आणि निपुती ती पण रडती
She who has one child cries, she who has two cries, she who
has seven cries, and she who has none she also cries. No one
is satisfied.
Marathi

असतील बाळ तर फेडतील काळ
If there be sons they will prevent misfortune.
Marathi

असत्याचा बाप नसत्याची आई
A father for the profitable son, a mother for the
unprofitable. 'In prosperity, a father; in adversity, a
mother' (Hindustani).
Marathi

आईच्या लाडामुळे मूल होई खुळें
By the mother's petting the child becomes an idiot.
Marathi

ఆడదానిచేతి అర్థమూ మొగవానిచేతి బిడ్డా బ్రతకదు
Money left in the hands of a woman wont last; a child left
in the hands of a man wont live.
Telugu

తల్లిని చూచి పిల్లనూ పాడిని చూచి బర్రెనూ తీసుకోవలెను
Look at the mother before you take the daughter; see how
much milk the buffalo gives before you buy her.
Telugu

లంజకు పిల్ల తఖలాటము
A child is a hindrance to a harlot.
Telugu

లంజ బిడ్డకు తండ్రి యెవరు
Who is the father of a harlot's child?
Telugu

पितृदुःखं तु षण्मासं मातृदुःखं तु वत्सरः। भार्यादुःखं पुनर्भार्या पुत्रदुःखं निरंतरं॥
Sorrow for [the loss of] a father [lasts] six months; sorrow
for a mother, a year; sorrow for a wife until a second wife
[comes]; sorrow for a son, for ever.
Sanskrit

data.name: Animals
text:
چې مېښکه راشي، د غوږونو ځای ورک شي
When a buffalo enters the shed, the cows lose their place
and status.
Pashto

د کم فصل چې وړو نه وي، هغه ته مال ورګډېږي
A field without a fence is vulnerable to wandering
livestock.
Pashto

خر په مال کې نه دی، زوم په رشتو کې نه دی
A donkey is no true livestock; a son-in-law is no true
relative.
Pashto

خرې ته چې "لیلا" ووایې بیا واښه نه خوري
Call a donkey "Laila" and she refuses to eat grass.
Pashto

پښتنو کور کې سپی نه وي، لیونی نه وي، هغه کور نه دی
A Pashtun home without a watchdog and a fierce man is no
real home.
Pashto

مرض دی گل تے گڈی دا پہیا اگے نوں جاندے نے
A man's word and the wheels of a moving vehicle always move
forward.
Punjabi

دورتیک رویو سار بیری نیسیرو گوردوغ جم
A traveling donkey is better than a homebound man.
Khowar

جنیں کاش ءِ گوک نوارث، مرد مکسکے من پگہ تلا انت۔
A woman is like dry grass that even a cow won't eat; a man
is a fly sitting proudly on a golden turban.
Balochi

جنک چو اسک ءَ ببیت، بچک چو شیر ءَ ببیت۔
A girl should be gentle like a deer, a boy should be brave
like a lion.
Balochi

دو پاد ءِ مات ءَ شر کن، چار پاد ءِ پِت ءَ۔
Ensure the mother of two feet (human) is good, and the
father of four feet (livestock) is good.
Balochi

तासा आड बैल आणि दिसा आड बायको मारावी
Beat a bullock every other furrow, and a wife every other
day. A Shudra proverb. 'A spaniel, a woman, and a walnut-
tree, the more they're beaten the better they will be'
(English).
Marathi

औदुंबराणि पुष्पाणि श्वेतवर्णं च वायसं। मत्स्यपदं जले पश्येन्नारीहृदयस्थितं॥
The flowers of the fig tree, a white-coloured crow, a fish's
foot in the water, one may see—but not what is in a woman's
mind.
Sanskrit

कदलीवंध्या काकीवंध्या॥
Barren as a plantain, barren as a crow. (A woman who has one
child and then dies is like the plantain which produces one
bunch and then perishes; a woman who brings forth once and
is afterwards barren is like the crow which lays eggs but
once.)
Sanskrit

د غرو په ټېګه خوږ شو، د کور مېچنه یې ماته کړه
Hurt by a rock on the mountain, he came home to break the
grinding stone.
Pashto

په یوې غلا سړی غل نه کېږي
A single theft does not define a man as a permanent thief.
Pashto

কালা কাজলের মাটি, তার লাইগ্যা ছয় মাস হাঁটি / ধলা ধুতরা ফুল, তার নাই এক পয়সা মূল
For dark kohl soil, one would walk for six months; a white
datura flower is not worth a single penny.
Bengali
